themes.description: Users consistently report that cashback earned from bill payments is not redeemable for bill payments or recharges, instead it is redirected to US stocks investments or locked in a separate rewards account. This misalignment between promised cashback utility and actual redemption options causes confusion, dissatisfaction, and perceived fraud.
themes.business_impact: The inability to use cashback for its intended purpose directly leads to customer churn, negative reviews, and loss of trust, potentially reducing monthly active users by up to 15% and lowering overall transaction volume on the platform.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The platform's reward engine currently redirects all cashback into a US‑stock investment account due to a legacy incentive program aimed at boosting stock trading volume. UI/UX fail to expose this rule, leading to user misinterpretation, while policy documentation is outdated.
themes.action_plan:
• Clarify cashback terms in the onboarding flow
• Update reward engine to allow direct redemption for bill payments
• Redesign cashback UI to display real-time redemption options
• Publish a transparent FAQ and policy update
• Roll out phased communication campaign
• Monitor redemption metrics and adjust policy as needed

themes.description: Users experience repeated, confusing, or failed eKYC verification, requiring multiple uploads, inconsistent matching, and lack of clear resolution, leading to frustration and abandonment.
themes.business_impact: High abandonment rate during onboarding, increased support tickets, delayed account activation, loss of potential customers, and negative brand perception, measurable through onboarding completion rates, support ticket volume, and churn within the first 30 days.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The eKYC system relies on a third‑party biometric matching service with insufficient error handling, combined with inconsistent internal logic that re‑requests documents after a failed match, and limited fallback for poor network conditions, causing repeated failures and user confusion.
themes.action_plan:
• Review third‑party eKYC integration and error handling
• Implement smoother fallback flow for low‑bandwidth users
• Consolidate required documents to a single upload
• Provide real‑time feedback on match status
• Enhance support ticket routing to dedicated KYC team
• Conduct user testing with diverse network scenarios
• Publish clear onboarding guide and FAQ
